chapter.verse: Hih hun sungin nungzui mite tam tektek uh a, tua laitak Hellenist-te in nisim nekledawn vaihawmna ah amau' meigongte hong kihamsiat ci-in Hebrew-kam zang mite phunsan uh hi.
Tua ciangin sawmlenihte in nungzui honpi bup sam uh a, “Pasian' thu thudon lo liangin sumlepai vai kong van ding uh kilawm lo hi.
Tua ahih manin sanggamte aw, no teng' sungpan Kha leh pilna tawh kidim, phatna ngah mi sagih hong kitengkhia unla hih a kitangsam nasep mun ah i seh ding hi.
Ko ka hih uhleh thungetna leh thugen seppina ah ka kipiakhia ding uh hi,” ci uh hi.

A thugen uh mihonpi bup lungkim uh ahih manin upna leh Kha Siangtho tawh a kidim Stephen banah Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, leh Antioch khuami biakna lutthak Nicolas, tu-a teng tengkhia uh hi.
Tua ciangin sawltakte' mai-ah paipih uh a, sawltakte in thungenin amaute' tungah a khutte uh nga uh hi.
Pasian' thu kizel semsem a, Jerusalem khua ah nungzui phazah nakpi-in a khan banah siampi tampitak in zong upna thu hong sang uh hi.
Stephen pen kilawmna leh vangliatna tawh kidim a, mite' lakah nalamdang leh kihilna lim a lianpipite bawl hi.
Tua ciangin Cyrene khua leh Alexandria khua-a om Sila Suakta a kici pawlte' vengkhawm pan hitaleh, Cilicia gam leh Asia gam pan hitaleh, mi kimkhat kithawi-in Stephen tawh kisel uh hi.
Ahih hangin tua mite in Stephen' thugenna ah a koppih pilna leh Kha lehpan zolo uh hi.
Tua ciangin golhguk tawh mi cial uh a, “Hih mipa, Moses leh Pasian gendaina kam a pau ka za uh hi,” cisak uh hi.
Tua bangin amaute in Jew mipite, Jew makaite leh laisiamte a sosuah khit uh ciangin Stephen' kiangah pai-in amah man uh a, Sanhedrin tun uh hi.
Tua ciangin teci zuaute sam uh a, “Hih mipa, hih siangtho huangmun leh thukhun langpanna kam pau thapai a,
tua Nazareth khuami Jesu in hih huangmun susia-in eite' tunga Moses hong apsawn ngeina zatziate khel ding hi, ci-a a gen ka za uh hi,” cisak uh hi.
Sanhedrin sunga tu makaite in Stephen limtak a et uh ciangin a maitang pen vanmi' maitang tawh kibang ahihlam a vekin mu uh hi.
